source_evidence: The ability to annuitize your variable annuity offers protection against the possibility that you will outlive your assets.
answer: A variable annuity can help address longevity risk—the possibility of outliving your assets—by allowing you to turn its value into regular income payments. Under most contracts, you can choose payments for a set period or for an indefinite period, such as your lifetime or your spouse’s lifetime. The available choices and payment amounts depend on the contract, so review its payout options carefully.
